newsitem.title: USA: Kansas fed cattle sales steady at $64, slow - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas fed cattle sales steady at $64, slow - USDA.

text.p: DODGE CITY, July 18 (Reuder) - Trade was slow, with a few sales slaughter steers and heifers steady, USDA said. Inquiry was good and demand moderate.

Sales confirmed on 100 slaughter steers and 400 slaughter heifers Friday. This week's confirmed sales 93,600 head including 24,900 head or about 27 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1225 lbs 64.00. Slaughter heifers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1100 lbs 64.00.
